prose: Monaco launched Agent Matrix, a product that deploys large numbers of coordinated agents with a single stated outcome: accelerating revenue growth. Founder Sam Blond announced the launch with an application-based early access program, pitching 24/7 agent workforces as the new baseline for go-to-market teams.
highlights: Monaco launched Agent Matrix: coordinated agent fleets aimed at revenue growth
Announced by Sam Blond with apply-for-early-access onboarding
Pitch: armies of agents working 24/7 on go-to-market outcomes
